correctness.rationale: All even rotations factor into length-two complementary morphism blocks and have common #01 count; their triple deck increments by signed Thue–Morse partial sums H in {-1,0,1}. The four odd block states yield four more pairwise distinct (#01,#001) values; balanced block counts give one class size 2^(k-2) and six of 2^(k-3). Independently recomputed all subsequence counts through order three for every rotation k<=9, including k=0..2 exceptions, verifying class sizes and two-statistic sufficiency; unrestricted k follows from morphism recurrences rather than finite tests.
